propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose relation graphs traverse that directory.
An event-less ticket directory is invisible to git and cannot be tracked or repaired via branch pulls, but persists in local clones and blocks plan reviews until manually removed.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate and skip event-less directories with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, while still raising errors for genuinely corrupt entries that hold malformed events.

The writer should NOT be changed to avoid creating directories before their first event, because cleanup cannot cover process-death orphans and races with concurrent writers under the shared store concurrency model.
A test must construct an event-less ticket directory and verify that review-plan on an unrelated ticket reaches a verdict, failing before the fix is applied.
